answer: Decaying Orchard Model.** Each new agent identity draws a compute quota from a shared pool whose marginal cost rises steeply with the count of identities already registered under the same funding root; unused quota decays over time. Any transaction must carry a fresh oracle signal proving liveness. An attacker registering N identities pays a superlinear toll at each onyx threshold, making mass registration cost far more than the value each fake agent can extract.
